title: OCPBUGS-141920: Patch existing CAPI machines without create fallback
body:
## What this PR does / why we need it

The NodePool controller updates previously listed CAPI Machines and AWSMachines with `CreateOrPatch`. If an object disappears after the list, the helper can attempt to create the stale object instead of skipping it.

Both propagation loops now use patch-only updates with `client.MergeFrom`:
- Skip objects whose desired state is unchanged.
- Log and skip `NotFound` from a patch.
- Continue processing remaining objects and aggregate other per-object errors. The Machine loop now continues after an error, matching the existing AWSMachine error-collection behavior.

Preserve list scope, NodePool ownership filtering, managed labels, global pull-secret labels, taints and AWS tag replacement semantics. Serialize NodePool taints once before the Machine loop. No API, CRD, RBAC, generated-file or config-hash changes.

## Tests

Fake-client interceptors delete an object after `List` and verify no `Create` or `Update` occurs, the deleted object stays absent, later objects are updated, other errors aggregate, and unchanged or unrelated objects are untouched. The regression cases fail against the original implementation and pass with the fix.

Validation passed: `make test`, `make verify`, `make build`, `make e2e` (compile), `make test-changed`, `make verify-quick`, `make verify-commit-layout`, and `make test-commit-layout`. Focused nodepool race tests and repeated regression runs also passed.

## Which issue(s) this PR fixes

Fixes OCPBUGS-141920

## Special notes for your reviewer

Deletion races are reproduced deterministically with the fake client. Live-cluster e2e and API-server/informer timing were not exercised locally; those remain unverified.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Improved updates to AWS machine tags and machine labels and taints, while leaving unrelated or already up-to-date machines unchanged.
  - Prevented reconciliation from recreating machines that were deleted during processing.
  - Ensured processing continues for other machines when an individual update fails, with errors reported after processing completes.
  - Avoided writes when the machine list cannot be retrieved, and surfaced the resulting error.

@@ -436,7 +438,14 @@ func (c *CAPI) awsMachineTemplate(ctx context.Context, templateNameGenerator fun
 	return template, nil
 }
 
+// reconcileAWSMachines updates the additional tags of the NodePool's existing
+// AWSMachines in place, so that tag changes do not require a rolling upgrade.
+// It only patches AWSMachines returned by the List: an AWSMachine that is deleted
+// before it is patched is skipped, and it is never created. AWSMachines that
+// already have the desired tags are not patched. Failures for individual
+// AWSMachines do not stop the loop; they are returned together.
 func (c *CAPI) reconcileAWSMachines(ctx context.Context) error {
+	log := ctrl.LoggerFrom(ctx)
 	awsMachines := &capiaws.AWSMachineList{}
 	if err := c.List(ctx, awsMachines, client.InNamespace(c.controlplaneNamespace), client.MatchingLabels{
 		capiv1.MachineDeploymentNameLabel: c.nodePool.Name,
@@ -446,10 +455,19 @@ func (c *CAPI) reconcileAWSMachines(ctx context.Context) error {
 
 	var errs []error
 	for _, machine := range awsMachines.Items {
-		if _, err := controllerutil.CreateOrPatch(ctx, c.Client, &machine, func() error {
-			machine.Spec.AdditionalTags = awsAdditionalTags(c.nodePool, c.hostedCluster, c.capiClusterName)
-			return nil
-		}); err != nil {
+		original := machine.DeepCopy()
+		machine.Spec.AdditionalTags = awsAdditionalTags(c.nodePool, c.hostedCluster, c.capiClusterName)
+		if equality.Semantic.DeepEqual(original, &machine) {
+			continue
+		}
+
+		// Patch instead of CreateOrPatch: a JSON merge patch never creates the
+		// AWSMachine if it was deleted after the List.
+		if err := c.Patch(ctx, &machine, client.MergeFrom(original)); err != nil {
+			if apierrors.IsNotFound(err) {
+				log.Info("AWSMachine no longer exists, skipping tag reconciliation", "awsMachine", client.ObjectKeyFromObject(&machine).String())
+				continue
+			}
 			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("failed to reconcile AWSMachine %s: %w", machine.Name, err))
 		}
 	}
